data.name: Emerald Necklace Tour
data.headline: 10AM • 3.5-4 Hours • Our Fall-Foliage Tour!
data.description:
##Tour Times
• 10am (after September 15th)

##Duration
• 3.5-4 hours long
• 15+ miles
• \*Please note that this tour is not recommended for inexperienced or young riders.

##Some of the highlights of this tour include:

- The Boston Common and Public Garden
- The famous Charles River Esplanade
- The Museum of Fine Arts and the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum
- The Rose Kennedy Greenway – Boston’s newest public park
- The Arnold Arboretum
- Jamaica Pond and Jamaica Plain
- The Southwest Corridor Park
- And many more exciting sights!

##Want to see an American masterpiece in landscaping? 

The Emerald Necklace tour is an amazing way to see Boston’s most famous green spaces in a ‘green’ way. 

Discover Frederick Law Olmsted’s famous system of parks on this bicycle tour of the historic Emerald Necklace. From the shaded boulevard on Commonwealth Avenue to the popular shores of Jamaica Pond to the winding paths of the Arnold Arboretum, come enjoy a route that’s a favorite among locals and the best way to see the green side of Boston. The Parks are gorgeous any time of the year, but the foliage peaks in color between mid October and early November.

This tour visits the Emerald Necklace, a series of parks designed by Fredrick Law Olmsted, that snake through different neighborhoods of Boston. 

All of our tours include an individually-fitted bicycle, helmet, water, and, of course, a friendly and knowledgeable guide who will lead you on your travels.


##Additional Information

This tour is not recommended for inexperienced or young riders. Participants must be comfortable riding 15+ miles over a time span of up to four hours. We do not allow tandem bikes, burley trailers, or trail-a-bikes on this tour.

While our guides will provide water, you might consider bringing a sports drink or snack as well as sunglasses and sunscreen. Any luggage, large bags, or bulky jackets can be left at the shop during the tour.

This tour may be scheduled as a private tour any time of the year. Please call us for more information.
data.cancellation_notes:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ - By booking, you are agreeing to accept these terms**

Within two weeks of your reserved event, tickets are NON-REFUNDABLE, but may be rescheduled for a $25 fee per ticket based on availability. Customers may cancel penalty-free up to 48 hours after booking, unless the event is within 14 days. We offer 50% refunds for cancellations made more than 14 days prior to the event. We cannot refund cancellations made within 14 days of an event because your space must be reserved. 

Rescheduling requests are subject to availability and are processed at the sole discretion of the employee making the transaction. Rescheduling requests received within 14 days of the event are subject to a fee of $25 per ticket to reschedule. Reservations may be rescheduled only once.

Failure to arrive 30 minutes before your tour’s departure time will result in your space on tour being given away. You will not receive a refund or credit for your tour. Late arrivals will not be caught up to the tour.

Our tours run rain or shine. In some circumstances, tours may be cancelled up to an hour before the start time of the event. The decision to cancel the tour is up to the sole discretion of Urban AdvenTours. If we cancel the event, ticket-holders may choose to reschedule tickets (subject to availability), to receive credit for a future event, or to receive a full refund.

Massachusetts law requires children to be at least 12 months of age while riding along on a bicycle. Children under the age of 12 months will not be allowed on rentals or tours. All children ages 16 and under are required to wear a helmet, and all guests are required to wear a helmet when participating on a UA-guided bike tour.
data.booking_notes:
##Meeting Place and Check In Time

* **Please arrive 30 minutes prior to the start of the tour** (9:30 am for 10:00 am tours and 1:30 pm for 2:00 pm tours) to sign paperwork and be fitted for your bike and helmet. **Late arrivals will not be caught up, refunded, or rescheduled.**
* An online waiver will be sent to you in a separate email. Please have all participants in your party fill out this waiver prior to your arrival.

* Urban AdvenTours is located at **103 Atlantic Ave** in Boston's North End, across the street from Christopher Columbus Park, and near the New England Aquarium and Faneuil Hall.
* The closest subway stops are the Aquarium stop on the Blue Line and the Haymarket stop on the Orange/Green Lines.
* Boston can be a difficult city to navigate if you are unfamiliar with the area! Leave plenty of time for navigating and plan a route ahead of time. 
* The closest parking options are Lewis Warf Parking Lot and North End Parking Garage.


##Please Note:

Please bring a water bottle (which you may fill for free at the shop), or you might consider bringing a sports drink or snack. In the summer months, sunscreen and sunglasses are highly recommended. Any luggage, large bags, or bulky jackets can be left at the shop during the tour.

**It is customary to tip your tour guide at the conclusion of the tour for a job well done.**


##What to Wear

• Please wear comfortable clothes appropriate for the weather including appropriate footwear - sneakers with good tread are best. Dress in layers for cooler weather or when there is a chance of precipitation.
• Please do NOT wear skirts, dress shoes, high heels, large purses, or any loose-fitting clothes that could get caught in the bike's chain.
• Forgot something? Colder than you expected? We have a bike shop stocked with quality cycling apparel and accessories - arrive early and we'll get you set up. If you take a tour with us, we offer 20% off apparel and accessories at our shop! 


##What to Bring/What Not to Bring

Please bring a water bottle (which you may fill for free at the shop), or you might consider bringing a sports drink or snack. We recommend that you bring a camera, sunglasses, and sun screen.
 
Please do NOT bring a large purse or other bulky bag that might become a burden during the tour. As there are limited storage facilities, please try only to bring what you need. We may be able to store luggage and larger bags with advance notice.
  
For safety reasons, the use of cellular phones while riding is prohibited.  You may bring your cell phone with you, but please refrain from using it during the tour. 


##Other Tips & Guidelines
Please arrive 30 minutes prior to the start of the tour to be fitted for your bike and helmet. 

Like us on Facebook to keep up with news and alerts from the shop regarding weather, special events, and potential delays. We'll send your tour photos out on Facebook too!

You do not need to print these pages! We only require a photo ID for tour attendees. 
Important: Any directions or maps provided by AdvenTours are only a rough guide. You are responsible for arriving at the activity's meeting location on time, so make sure to check with a second source that can provide specific directions from your starting point.


##Detailed Directions 
Urban AdvenTours is located at 103 Atlantic Ave in Boston's North End, across the street from Christopher Columbus Park, and near the New England Aquarium and Faneuil Hall.  The closest subway stop is the Aquarium stop on the Blue Line. YOU MUST PLAN YOUR ROUTE AHEAD OF TIME. WE CANNOT OFFER 'TURN-BY-TURN' DIRECTIONS OVER THE PHONE.

Urban AdvenTours highly recommends using public transit. During weekday commute times, driving into the city can take hours and parking is extremely difficult. Many MBTA and Commuter Rail stations have parking lots available. Our shop is a 15 minute walk from North Station and a 25 minute walk from South Station. Visit www.mbta.com to plan your trip on public transit.

If you are taking the subway, we are near the Aquarium stop on the Blue Line, the Haymarket stop on the Green and Orange Lines, and the State Street stop on the Orange and Blue Lines. We can also be reached from the Government Center Stop (Green and Blue lines) and Park Street Stop (Green and Red lines).  The Aquarium Stop is closest to our shop, but transferring between lines can be time consuming.

There is no street parking at our location. There are several parking garages nearby. The most convenient are Standard Parking at 260 Commercial St. (617)367-1681, and the Government Center Garage at 50 New Sudbury St. (617)227-0385.
 
**Subway Directions** 
**From Aquarium Station/New England Aquarium (Blue Line)** 
Walk north on Atlantic Ave/Surface Road past Columbus Park
Turn right on Atlantic Ave

**From Haymarket Station (Orange/Green Lines)** 
Walk South down the Surface Road
Turn left at Mercantile St and cross the Greenway
Mercantile St becomes Atlantic Ave

**From State Street Station (Orange and Blue Lines)** 
Walk East down State Street towards the water
Cross the Greenway and turn left
Walk past Columbus Park
Turn right on Atlantic Ave

**From Government Center Station (Blue and Green Lines)** 
Walk through City Hall Plaza
Cross Congress Street
Walk through Faneuil Hall/Quincy Market
Cross the Greenway and turn left
Turn right on Atlantic Ave
